user.title: Add Zemismart ZM208 Display Switch
user.description: Enter the IP address of your ZM208 switch. The switch must be on the same local network as Home Assistant. Supports ZM208-1 through ZM208-4 (horizontal and vertical).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Zemismart ZM208 Found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found a Zemismart ZM208 display switch at {host} (MAC: {mac}). Add it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check the IP address and that the switch is on the same local network as Home Assistant.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.not_zemismart: Device is not a Zemismart ZM208.
abort.no_host: Could not determine device IP address.
